name: pending-state-roster-literal-duplication
body: The unit test writes the 15 durable node-table labels out literally because `DURABLE_NODE_TABLES` is private to `artifacts::db`, so the roster now exists in two places; a production roster change fails the test loudly, which is the intended signal. Upgrade to a crate-visible roster accessor if keeping the two copies in step ever becomes burdensome.
